# Copy this file to .env.local and change the values as needed.
# Never put secrets here: every VITE_* variable is bundled into the public JavaScript.

# Leave empty in development: Vite forwards /api/* to the FastAPI back end (see vite.config.js).
# For a production build, set it to the API's origin, e.g. https://api.example.com
VITE_API_URL=

# true = answer from the built-in demo responses (src/api/mock.js) so the UI can be
# developed without the back end. Must be false for the real application.
VITE_USE_MOCK=false
VITE_USE_MOCK=false
